text:
Ava: Quick sync — proposing a small UX pass on the trace viewer flamegraph: make node focus visible, clarify keyboard nav order, and surface the export action in the node/context menu. Thoughts? cc @Ravi @Sam :memo:
Ravi: Tab order question: should timeline scrub come before node details? Many users scrub first.
Sam: For SRs it's better to expose node details first. My suggestion: node -> details panel -> timeline scrub -> export. Keeps semantic flow.
Marta: Accessibility checklist: aria-label on flame nodes, role=button for clickable spans, aria-live region for selection changes. Also ensure focus isn't lost when export dialog opens.
Olivia: Copy nit: current export says "Export trace" — prefer explicit labels: "Download trace snapshot (.json)", "Export spans (.csv)".
Ava: Draft copy options: - "Download trace snapshot (.json)" - "Export span list (.csv)" - "Copy correlation ID" (clipboard) :clipboard: (with success toast)
Sam: For the copy flow add an aria-live announcement and a subtle tooltip: "Correlation ID copied" (role=status). Prevent duplicate focus shifts.
Ava: Tiny CSS proposal for high-contrast focus ring:
```css
.flame-node:focus { outline: 3px solid #0055aa; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,85,170,0.12); }
```
Ravi: Good contrast choice. Remember dark-mode tokens.
Marta: Keyboard shortcuts idea: when a node is focused: "c" = copy corr id, "e" = open export menu. We need a conflict matrix with global shortcuts.
Sam: I'll ship shortcuts behind a feature flag and ensure focus returns after dialogs. Adding UA fallbacks for legacy browsers.
Olivia: Microcopy tweak: shorten toast to "Links related requests" instead of the longer sentence.
Ava: Can we A/B test copy + focus ring? 25% rollout sounds reasonable.
Ravi: Product can do 25%. Sam, add metrics to track CTR on export and copy.
Sam: Adding events: trace_export_click, span_csv_export, corrid_copy.
deploy-bot: design-prototypes/trace-flamegraph-v2 deployed to staging (build #2213). :sparkles:
Ava: I'll update Figma with focus order, aria attributes, and final copy. Please drop any last nits in the file. :eyes:
